tracks.name: Full-stack Web Development
tracks.description: Create accessible, responsive web applications and take them to production.

phases.title: Foundations & Core Mechanics
topics: Semantic HTML5, ARIA, accessible forms, WCAG 2.1 AA contrast and focus
CSS architecture, box model, cascade layers, Flexbox, Grid, Tailwind methodology, container queries
JavaScript ESNext: scope, TDZ, closures, prototypes, this, event loop, promises, modules, Map and Set
Common pitfalls: async map, event-loop ordering, flex min-width: 0, event propagation and delegation
phases.project: Build a responsive, no-framework portfolio/blog with a dynamic gallery; target Lighthouse accessibility score of at least 95.
checkpoints: Explain bubbling, capturing, and event delegation

phases.title: Intermediate Architecture & Applied Workflows
topics: TypeScript: types, generics, utility types, narrowing
React hooks, custom hooks, controlled inputs, context, state tools, React Query
Next.js App Router, server/client components, SSR, SSG, ISR, Server Actions, fetching and cache
Node backend with Express/Nest, middleware, REST, Zod and dependency injection
PostgreSQL normalization, indexes, transactions, Prisma/Drizzle
phases.project: Build a CRUD task app with Next.js, Prisma and PostgreSQL, auth-gated routes, optimistic updates and validated Server Actions.

projectBrief.outcome: Deliver a working authenticated task-management application with a typed React interface, Next.js App Router pages, validated server mutations, and PostgreSQL persistence.
requiredFeatures: Create, list, edit, complete, and delete tasks; each task belongs to an authenticated owner.
Use TypeScript domain contracts and runtime validation for untrusted API input; narrow unknown values and avoid avoidable any.
Use controlled React forms and derive display values during render; reserve effects for external synchronization with cleanup.
Use App Router layouts and deliberate server/client boundaries; provide loading, empty, success, and error states.
Validate mutation inputs with Zod and enforce authentication plus per-task authorization on the server.
Keep handlers thin; inject a repository into a service and test the service with a fake repository.
Use normalized PostgreSQL tables, keys, constraints, a justified index, and transactions for multi-step writes.
Document rendering/cache decisions and refresh affected route data after successful mutations.
deliverables: Runnable source, setup instructions, and an environment example with no real secrets.
Database schema, versioned migration, and repeatable seed/local setup.
Automated tests for validation, service logic, authorization, and failure/transaction cases.
README with architecture, action/API contract, data model, test commands, and cache/revalidation rationale.
acceptance: Users can manage only their own tasks; cross-owner access is denied.
Blank, overlong, or malformed inputs produce stable safe errors.
Successful writes appear in the list after the documented revalidation behavior.
Failed multi-step writes leave no partial related records.
A clean setup reproduces the documented tests and behavior.

assessment: Accurate domain contracts; runtime validation and narrowing at untrusted boundaries; no avoidable any.
Correct hook usage and state scope; intentional route and server/client structure; complete UI states.
Thin handlers, server-side validation/authorization, safe errors, injected testable dependencies.
Sound relationships and constraints; query-justified index; atomic multi-step writes.
Normal and edge-case tests, reproducible setup, clear architecture and trade-off explanation.

phases.title: Advanced Internals, Systems Design & Edge Cases
topics: JavaScript engine internals: V8 object shapes, inline caching, garbage collection and memory-leak diagnosis
Advanced React: Fiber reconciliation, transitions, deferred rendering, Suspense, error boundaries and composition patterns
Advanced TypeScript: conditional and mapped types, template literal types, variance and declaration merging
Scalable API design: token-bucket rate limiting, idempotency keys, webhook delivery and API versioning
Database depth: EXPLAIN ANALYZE, composite/partial/covering indexes, connection pooling, read replicas and N+1 remediation
Application security: JWT validation and refresh rotation, OAuth2 PKCE, CSRF/XSS, parameterized SQL and secrets management
phases.project: Extend the Phase 02 task app with a real-time feature (WebSockets or SSE), Redis-backed rate limiting, and measured remediation of an intentionally introduced N+1 query. Begin the multi-tenant SaaS architecture with tenant isolation, RBAC and audit logging; finish production delivery in Phase 4.
checkpoints: Read EXPLAIN ANALYZE and justify an index using actual plan evidence
Explain Fiber scheduling and demonstrate a responsive transition/deferred view
Design refresh-token rotation with atomic replay detection
Use a heap snapshot and retaining paths to diagnose a memory leak
Explain read-replica consistency limits and CAP-related trade-offs

phases.title: Production Mastery & Capstone
topics: Docker and production image optimization
GitHub Actions CI/CD, cloud deployment and zero-downtime migrations
Observability, structured logging and incident debugging
Redis, sessions, caching and cache invalidation
RBAC and tenant isolation
phases.project: Deliver a containerized multi-tenant SaaS with CI/CD, caching, RBAC, tenant isolation, logging, a public URL and monitoring.

tracks.name: Python
tracks.description: Learn Python fundamentals, concurrency, testing, and package delivery.

phases.title: Foundations & Core Mechanics
topics: Core syntax, truthiness and mutability
Built-in data structures, algorithmic complexity and memory
Strings and encoding
Functions, default arguments, *args/**kwargs and LEGB scope
phases.project: Create a CLI finance tracker that reads and writes CSV files and produces reports.
checkpoints: Trace aliasing and object identity with id()

phases.title: Intermediate Architecture & Applied Workflows
topics: Generators and iterators
Decorators and context managers
OOP, dunder methods, dataclasses and abstract base classes
Functional patterns, type hints, Protocol and mypy
phases.project: Build a library-management system using dataclasses, context managers, decorators and type hints; run strict mypy.
checkpoints: Write context managers in both styles

phases.title: Advanced Internals, Systems Design & Edge Cases
topics: GIL and Python memory management
Metaclasses
Threading, multiprocessing and asyncio
Race conditions, locks, bounded concurrency and cancellation
phases.project: Build an async scraper with bounded concurrency and cancellation, with multiprocessing fallback where appropriate.
checkpoints: Compare threads and processes for CPU-bound work
Resolve a race condition with a lock

phases.title: Production Mastery & Capstone
topics: Virtual environments and Poetry/uv
pytest fixtures, mocking, coverage and Hypothesis
Packaging, PyPI and pyproject.toml
pathlib, logging, dataclasses, cache and argparse
phases.project: Package the async scraper as a CLI with pytest coverage above 85%, mocked network calls and structured logs; make it publish-ready.

tracks.name: Excel
tracks.description: Build reliable workbooks, dynamic models, and executive dashboards.

phases.title: Foundations & Core Mechanics
topics: Calculation engine, relative/absolute/mixed references, dependency graph and circular references
Tables, structured references and named ranges
SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, AVERAGEIFS, IF/IFS, IFERROR and VLOOKUP limitations
Conditional formatting, custom number formats and data validation
phases.project: Build an expense workbook using Tables, SUMIFS, dropdowns and conditional formatting.
checkpoints: Explain how inserted columns can affect VLOOKUP

phases.title: Intermediate Architecture & Applied Workflows
topics: Dynamic arrays: UNIQUE, SORT, FILTER, spill behavior and SEQUENCE
XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, CHOOSECOLS and CHOOSEROWS
LET and LAMBDA
Data Tables, Goal Seek and Scenario Manager
phases.project: Build a dynamic sales dashboard with cascading dropdowns, LAMBDA and sensitivity analysis.
checkpoints: Use a spill range in a dropdown

phases.title: Advanced Internals, Systems Design & Edge Cases
topics: Power Query: merge, append, unpivot, pivot, group by, Applied Steps and M basics
Query folding, parameters and custom functions
Power Pivot star schema, relationships and calculated columns versus measures
Introductory DAX: SUM, CALCULATE, RELATED and TOTALYTD
phases.project: Build a multi-source Power Query pipeline, unpivot messy data, create a star schema and write 3–5 measures.

phases.title: Production Mastery & Capstone
topics: Dynamic dashboards and executive reporting
Formula auditing and #N/A, #SPILL and #CALC errors
Workbook performance and volatile functions
Documented audit trail and scenario analysis
phases.project: Deliver an executive dashboard workbook with a Power Query-fed star schema, dynamic KPI cards, slicers, charts, scenario analysis and an audit trail.

tracks.name: Power BI
tracks.description: Transform data, model it, build DAX measures, and deliver governed BI.

phases.title: Foundations & Core Mechanics
topics: Connect to SQL, Excel, web and folder sources
Power Query ETL and incremental refresh
Report visuals, slicers and filters
Data types, data categorization and sort by column
phases.project: Load a multi-table sample dataset, transform it and build a multi-page report.

phases.title: Intermediate Architecture & Applied Workflows
topics: Kimball dimensional modeling: star versus snowflake, facts, dimensions, grain and surrogate keys
Relationships: cardinality, filter direction, bridge tables and role-playing dimensions
Introductory DAX: CALCULATE, FILTER and time intelligence
Excel Power Query/data-modeling prerequisite: complete Excel Phase 3 first
phases.project: Create a star-schema sales model and at least five DAX measures.

phases.title: Advanced Internals, Systems Design & Edge Cases
topics: DAX row context, filter context and context transition
CALCULATE filter modifiers and evaluation order
Semi-additive measures, time intelligence and custom calendars
Iterators: SUMX, AVERAGEX and RANKX
Report UX: bookmarks, drillthrough, tooltips and accessibility
phases.project: Build a financial report with balances, Top-N analysis, drillthrough and bookmarks.

phases.title: Production Mastery & Capstone
topics: Performance Analyzer, DAX Studio query plans and server timings
VertiPaq compression and cardinality
Static and dynamic row-level security with USERPRINCIPALNAME
Governance: refresh, workspaces, pipelines and dataflows
phases.project: Deliver a governed BI solution with star schema, 10+ optimized measures, dynamic RLS, three slow visuals optimized with before/after timings, Dev/Test/Prod pipeline and scheduled refresh.
checkpoints: Distinguish Storage Engine and Formula Engine

sequenceNote: Excel Track Phase 3 introduces Power Query and data modeling that scaffold Power BI Track Phase 2. Complete Excel Phase 3 before beginning Power BI Phase 2. Full-stack and Python can be studied in parallel from day one.
sourceNote: The four tracks and phase outlines follow the supplied Master Syllabus. Detailed guided lessons, worked examples, practice tasks, and official reference links are currently authored for Phase 1 across all four tracks. Phases 2–4 remain syllabus outlines and need lesson authoring before they can be considered complete.
